zh-CN.headlineView: 世界在交接与风险边界间前行
zh-CN.headlineFull: 十球铜牌战落幕；世界在交接与风险边界间前行
zh-CN.intro: 世界杯铜牌战、AI价值与OPC信心，与美伊冲突、英国换帅、秘鲁地震、中国经济和纽约疫情，共同指向治理、韧性与可验证的结果。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 变化越快，越要用清楚的边界、可靠的系统和能落地的指标判断进展。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 今天信息很多，先把事实排好队。

en-US.headlineView: the world moves through handovers and risk limits
en-US.headlineFull: A ten-goal bronze match closes; the world tests handovers and risk limits
en-US.intro: The World Cup bronze match, AI value and OPC confidence join U.S.-Iran escalation, Britain's handover, Peru's earthquake, China's economy and New York's outbreak in one theme: governance, resilience and verifiable outcomes.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The faster change moves, the more we need clear boundaries, reliable systems and measurable results.
en-US.doudouQuote: Lots of news today; line up the facts first.

sources.title: England men achieve best World Cup finish since 1966

zh-CN.headlineFact: 英格兰6比4击败法国获季军
zh-CN.headlineFull: 英格兰6比4击败法国获季军；决赛结果留到下一期
zh-CN.intro: 北京时间7月19日05:00至20日05:00，英格兰6比4战胜法国获得季军，萨卡上演帽子戏法。西班牙对阿根廷决赛在截止时仍未完赛，结果不计入本期。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 固定窗口让每日赛果可比较，热度不能替代统计边界。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 十个进球够热闹，截止线还是要守。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：世界杯日报。

en-US.headlineView: the final belongs to the next issue
en-US.headlineFull: England beat France 6-4 for bronze; the final belongs to the next issue
en-US.intro: From 05:00 Jul 19 to 05:00 Jul 20 Beijing time, England beat France 6-4 for bronze as Bukayo Saka scored a hat-trick. Spain-Argentina was unfinished at the cutoff and is excluded.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A fixed window keeps daily results comparable; excitement cannot replace the cutoff.
en-US.doudouQuote: Ten goals were plenty; the deadline still stands.

sources.title: England men achieve best World Cup finish since 1966
Saka hat-trick seals 6-4 England win over France

zh-CN.headlineFull: OpenAI提出AI价值四项记分卡；Token低价不等于任务便宜
zh-CN.intro: OpenAI建议企业用有用工作量、成功任务成本、可靠性和规模价值衡量AI投入，把注意力从每Token价格转向真正完成且可用的成果。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI采购真正要算的是一次成功交付的总成本，包括重试、复核和返工。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 便宜的Token若要改五遍，也可能最贵。

en-US.headlineFact: OpenAI proposes four measures for AI value
en-US.headlineView: cheap tokens do not mean cheap outcomes
en-US.headlineFull: OpenAI proposes four AI-value measures; cheap tokens do not mean cheap outcomes
en-US.intro: OpenAI says companies should measure useful work, cost per successful task, dependability and value at scale, shifting attention from token price to outcomes people can actually use.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The real AI cost includes retries, review and rework needed for one successful delivery.
en-US.doudouQuote: A cheap token can be expensive after five rewrites.

sources.title: A scorecard for the AI age

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国小企业乐观指数升至97.4
zh-CN.headlineView: 回暖不等于现金流无忧
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国小企业乐观指数升至97.4；回暖不等于现金流无忧
zh-CN.intro: NFIB称6月小企业乐观指数上升2.1点至97.4，接近52年均值；不确定性仍高，32%的受访企业报告岗位难以招满。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一人公司先看需求、现金流与交付，不要把宏观回暖直接当成自己的订单。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 信心回来了，账单可没休假。

en-US.headlineView: better mood does not erase cash-flow risk
en-US.headlineFull: U.S. small-business optimism rises to 97.4; cash-flow risk remains
en-US.intro: NFIB says its June index rose 2.1 points to 97.4, near its 52-year average. Uncertainty stayed high, while 32% of firms reported openings they could not fill.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Solo firms should track demand, cash flow and delivery—not mistake a macro rebound for orders.
en-US.doudouQuote: Confidence is back; the bills never took leave.

sources.title: Small Business Optimism Picks Up in June

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美军再报告一人死于伊朗无人机残骸
zh-CN.headlineView: 战争成本延伸到未爆弹
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美军再报告一人死于伊朗无人机残骸；战争成本延伸到未爆弹
zh-CN.intro: 美军称一名人员在伊拉克处置被击落伊朗无人机的未爆弹时死亡；此前约旦袭击已致两名美军死亡、另有一人失踪。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 冲突的危险不会随拦截结束，残骸、误判和报复都在延长风险链条。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 天空安静了，地上的危险还没清零。

en-US.headlineFact: Another U.S. troop dies handling Iranian drone ordnance
en-US.headlineFull: Another U.S. troop dies handling Iranian drone ordnance; war's risk chain widens
en-US.intro: The U.S. military says a service member died in Iraq during a controlled detonation of unexploded ordnance from a downed Iranian drone, following the deadly Jordan attack.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Danger does not end with interception; debris, miscalculation and retaliation extend the risk chain.
en-US.doudouQuote: The sky is quiet; the danger on the ground is not.

sources.title: US announces another troop death as Israel warns Tehran's attacks are coming close
U.S. military finds service member's remains after missile attack

zh-CN.headlineFact: 伯纳姆将于周一入主唐宁街
zh-CN.headlineView: 换帅易，财政难题不会自动换掉
zh-CN.headlineFull: 伯纳姆将于周一入主唐宁街；财政难题不会自动换掉
zh-CN.intro: 工党新领袖安迪·伯纳姆将于周一接任英国首相，面对生活成本、公共服务、移民、财政空间与对外政策等多重压力。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 领导人更替能重置叙事，却不能跳过预算、执行和信任修复。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 钥匙能交接，待办清单不会消失。

en-US.headlineFact: Andy Burnham enters Downing Street Monday
en-US.headlineView: a new leader does not erase fiscal constraints
en-US.headlineFull: Andy Burnham enters Downing Street Monday; fiscal constraints remain
en-US.intro: Labour's new leader is set to become U.K. prime minister Monday, facing pressure over living costs, public services, migration, limited fiscal room and foreign policy.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A leadership change can reset the story, but not skip budgets, execution or rebuilding trust.
en-US.doudouQuote: The keys transfer; the task list stays.

sources.title: What to know about the challenges Andy Burnham will face as UK prime minister
Andy Burnham becomes British Labour leader; next stop prime minister

zh-CN.headlineFact: 秘鲁5.5级地震致至少6人死亡
zh-CN.headlineView: 建筑韧性决定灾害放大倍数
zh-CN.headlineFull: 秘鲁5.5级地震致至少6人死亡；建筑韧性决定灾害放大倍数
zh-CN.intro: 秘鲁安第斯地区5.5级地震致至少6人死亡、30多人受伤、300人流离失所。当地部门称土坯材料加重了建筑损毁。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 同样的震级落在不同建筑与治理体系上，会变成完全不同的代价。

en-US.headlineFact: Peru's 5.5 quake kills at least six
en-US.headlineView: building resilience shapes the human cost
en-US.headlineFull: Peru's 5.5 quake kills at least six; building resilience shapes the human cost
en-US.intro: A magnitude-5.5 quake in Peru's Andes killed at least six, injured more than 30 and displaced 300. Local officials said adobe construction worsened damage.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The same magnitude can produce a different cost under different buildings and public systems.
en-US.doudouQuote: The quake was brief; rebuilding will not be.

sources.title: 5.5 magnitude earthquake hits Peru's Andes region and kills at least 6 people
Earthquake in Peru leaves at least six dead

zh-CN.headlineView: 出口韧性难掩内需失衡
zh-CN.headlineFull: 中国二季度GDP增长4.3%；出口韧性难掩内需失衡
zh-CN.intro: 国家统计局称上半年GDP同比增长4.7%，二季度增长4.3%。官方同时指出外部不稳定上升，供强需弱的矛盾仍较突出。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 供给与出口能托住增长，但居民信心和内需决定修复能否持续。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 生产线跑得快，购物车也得跟上。

en-US.headlineView: export resilience cannot hide weak demand
en-US.headlineFull: China's Q2 GDP grows 4.3%; export resilience cannot hide weak demand
en-US.intro: China's statistics bureau says first-half GDP grew 4.7% and Q2 grew 4.3%. Officials also highlighted rising external uncertainty and a persistent supply-demand imbalance.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Supply and exports can support growth, but household confidence and demand decide its durability.
en-US.doudouQuote: Fast factories still need fuller shopping carts.

sources.title: National Economy Operated within an Appropriate Range with New Growth Drivers Developing Rapidly in the First Half Year
sources.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China

sources.title: China's economy grew at a 4.3% annual pace in the 2nd quarter

zh-CN.headlineFact: 纽约军团菌病疫情报告第二例死亡
zh-CN.headlineView: 源头控制仍需持续验证
zh-CN.headlineFull: 纽约军团菌病疫情报告第二例死亡；源头控制仍需持续验证
zh-CN.intro: 纽约市卫生部门报告上东区军团菌病聚集性疫情出现第二例相关死亡，并称现有证据显示暴露源可能已经消除。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 公共卫生的信任来自透明更新、快速排查和把“可能”与“确认”分开。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 冷却塔洗干净，监测表还不能收。

en-US.headlineFact: NYC Legionnaires' cluster reports a second death
en-US.headlineFull: NYC Legionnaires' cluster reports a second death; source control needs verification
en-US.intro: New York City's health department reported a second death linked to the Upper East Side cluster and said evidence suggests the exposure source has likely been eliminated.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Public-health trust comes from rapid investigation and keeping likely separate from confirmed.
en-US.doudouQuote: The towers are cleaned; the monitoring sheet stays open.

sources.title: Second death reported in Legionnaires' disease outbreak in New York City
NYC Health Department Reports Second Death in Upper East Side Legionnaires' Disease Cluster
